race.iourusraces.human.tooltip.before: Adaptable and versatile, humans are well-balanced and ready to face any challenge.
race.iourusraces.human.tooltip.after: Humans are adaptable adventurers with balanced strengths and no special weaknesses.

race.iourusraces.orc.description.after: Powerful warriors who fight harder when hurt.

race.iourusraces.orc.tooltip.before: Gain +2 melee and +1 ranged damage at full health. At 40/30/20% health, bonuses rise to +3/4/5 melee and +1.5/2/2.5 ranged damage. Attack speed and bow/crossbow draw speed are 10% slower.
race.iourusraces.orc.tooltip.after: Orcs are strong warriors who hit harder as their health falls. They have more health, but attack and draw bows more slowly.

race.iourusraces.goblin.description.after: Small, quick explorers who see in the dark.

race.iourusraces.goblin.tooltip.before: Small and elusive, goblins rely on superior speed and agility to stay one step ahead.
race.iourusraces.goblin.tooltip.after: Goblins are small and quick. They jump higher and see in the dark, but have much less health.

race.iourusraces.elf.trait.2.before: + Slow falling and solid leaf footing

race.iourusraces.elf.description.after: Quick forest dwellers who land gently.

race.iourusraces.elf.tooltip.before: Forest dwellers with +8% movement speed, enhanced jumps and slow falling. Elves walk on leaves and cannot pass through them. No racial night vision or projectile-damage bonus.
race.iourusraces.elf.tooltip.after: Elves move quickly, jump higher and fall gently. They can stand on leaves, but have less health.

race.iourusraces.dwarf.description.after: Tough miners who work quickly underground.

race.iourusraces.dwarf.tooltip.before: Sturdy miners with +2 armor, 22 HP and improved mining efficiency.
race.iourusraces.dwarf.tooltip.after: Dwarves have tough skin, extra health and a talent for mining. Their short legs make them slower.

race.iourusraces.melfork.description.before: Aquatic warriors at their strongest beneath the waves.
race.iourusraces.melfork.description.after: Aquatic warriors who are strongest underwater.

race.iourusraces.melfork.tooltip.before: Melforks are naturally adapted to aquatic life. They can breathe and see underwater and become stronger while submerged, but suffer from weakness on land.
race.iourusraces.melfork.tooltip.after: Melforks breathe and see underwater and move easily through water. They hit harder while submerged, but their attacks are weaker on land.

race.iourusraces.draconic.description.before: Extremely resilient warriors descended from dragons.
race.iourusraces.draconic.description.after: Tough dragonkin who can endure fire and lava.

race.iourusraces.draconic.tooltip.before: Draconics possess extraordinary resilience and can swim through lava, making them exceptional frontline tanks.
race.iourusraces.draconic.tooltip.after: Draconics have much more health and are immune to fire. They can travel through lava more easily, but move slowly.
